permitInfo: USACE hunting permit required. Hunters 17 and older purchase a permit through Recreation.gov; one permit covers both Whitney and Aquilla Lakes for all authorized game and seasons. Hunters 12-16 must be accompanied by a permitted adult.

name: Bardwell Lake
permitInfo: No USACE hunting permit required. Follow the Texas Outdoor Annual for Ellis County. Feral hog hunting is only permitted north of State Highway 34.
means: Archery (crossbows allowed). Shotgun limited to non-toxic #2 shot or smaller for small game, upland and migratory birds, and waterfowl; rifled or sabot slugs allowed for feral hogs only. No rifles, pistols, muzzleloaders, or buckshot.
legalGameText: Archery (crossbows allowed). Shotgun limited to non-toxic #2 shot or smaller for small game, upland and migratory birds, and waterfowl; rifled or sabot slugs allowed for feral hogs only. No rifles, pistols, muzzleloaders, or buckshot.
boundaryNote: Map boundary is the Corps project land from USGS PAD-US, not the hunt compartments in the lake PDF.

name: Belton Lake
permitInfo: USACE permit required for white-tailed deer (archery-only quota hunt by lottery through Recreation.gov; applications in September). Other legal game is open per the Texas Outdoor Annual in designated areas. Feral hog hunting is year-round.
permitCost: No fee; deer permit issued by lottery.
means: Archery only for white-tailed deer and feral hog. Shotgun (non-toxic #2 shot or smaller) for all other species. No muzzleloaders, rifles, pistols, slugs, or shot larger than #2.
legalGameText: Archery only for white-tailed deer and feral hog. Shotgun (non-toxic #2 shot or smaller) for all other species. No muzzleloaders, rifles, pistols, slugs, or shot larger than #2.
boundaryNote: Map boundary is the Corps project land from USGS PAD-US, not the hunt compartments in the lake PDF.

name: Benbrook Lake
permitInfo: USACE hunting permit required; the number of applicants is limited and hunters are selected by a random drawing for each season. Permits are valid September 1 to January 31. Contact the Benbrook Lake office for permit instructions.
permitCost: No fee; permit by random drawing.
means: Archery only for deer, turkey, and feral hog. Shotgun (non-toxic #2 shot or smaller) for other game. No pistols, rifles, muzzleloaders, slugs, or shot larger than #2.
legalGameText: Archery only for deer, turkey, and feral hog. Shotgun (non-toxic #2 shot or smaller) for other game. No pistols, rifles, muzzleloaders, slugs, or shot larger than #2.
boundaryNote: Map boundary is the Corps project land from USGS PAD-US, not the hunt compartments in the lake PDF.

name: Lake Georgetown
permitInfo: USACE permit required. Deer and feral hog archery permits are by random drawing (archery proficiency test and hunter safety certification required); apply via Recreation.gov, normally June 1 through end of June. Small-game permits (50 total) are by random drawing with applications starting in July. Hunting runs September 27 through January 11.
permitCost: $10 non-refundable archery application; $90 archery permit if drawn; $25 small-game application.
means: Archery only for deer and feral hog. Shotgun only (non-toxic #2 shot or smaller) for small game and waterfowl. No rifles, pistols, muzzleloaders, slugs, or shot larger than #2.
legalGameText: Archery only for deer and feral hog. Shotgun only (non-toxic #2 shot or smaller) for small game and waterfowl. No rifles, pistols, muzzleloaders, slugs, or shot larger than #2.
boundaryNote: Map boundary is the Corps project land from USGS PAD-US, not the hunt compartments in the lake PDF.

name: Grapevine Lake
permitInfo: USACE permit required. Archery deer permits are by lottery (apply July 1-31). 500 waterfowl permits are by lottery (shooting hours end at noon). 800 general hunting permits for other legal game are first-come, first-served starting August 15. Youth 16 and under may archery hunt deer without a permit but must file a waiver.
permitCost: No fee; permits by lottery or first-come.
means: Archery only for deer and feral hog. Shotgun (shot size #2 or smaller) for other game. No muzzleloaders, rifles, or pistols.
legalGameText: Archery only for deer and feral hog. Shotgun (shot size #2 or smaller) for other game. No muzzleloaders, rifles, or pistols.
boundaryNote: Map boundary is the Corps project land from USGS PAD-US, not the hunt compartments in the lake PDF.

name: Lake O' the Pines
permitInfo: No USACE hunting permit required. Follow the Texas Outdoor Annual for Camp, Harrison, Marion, Morris, and Upshur counties. All hunting is prohibited June 1 through August 31. ATV permits for hunting areas south of the dam and west of Cypress Creek are available for persons with a permanent ambulatory disability.
means: Archery, muzzleloading rifles, and shotguns allowed. Centerfire/rimfire rifles for deer or hogs allowed only south of the dam and west of Cypress Creek and north of Highway 155; all other areas use shotgun slugs/sabots, muzzleloaders, or archery. Shotguns limited to non-toxic #2 shot or smaller.
legalGameText: Archery, muzzleloading rifles, and shotguns allowed. Centerfire/rimfire rifles for deer or hogs allowed only south of the dam and west of Cypress Creek and north of Highway 155; all other areas use shotgun slugs/sabots, muzzleloaders, or archery. Shotguns limited to non-toxic #2 shot or smaller.
boundaryNote: Map boundary is the Corps project land from USGS PAD-US, not the hunt compartments in the lake PDF.

name: Lavon Lake
permitInfo: USACE permit required for all hunters 17 and older (issued Aug 15 - Nov 15; returning hunters may reregister online at lavonlakehunting.tamu.edu). Deer hunting is closed until population data supports a harvest. Waterfowl allowed in Hunting Areas 1-14 only.
permitCost: No fee; permit required for all species.
means: Archery for feral hog in all areas; shotgun with slugs allowed for hogs in Areas 6-13. Shotgun (shot #2 or smaller) for other game. No rifles, handguns, airguns, or muzzleloaders. Deer hunting is prohibited.
legalGameText: Archery for feral hog in all areas; shotgun with slugs allowed for hogs in Areas 6-13. Shotgun (shot #2 or smaller) for other game. No rifles, handguns, airguns, or muzzleloaders. Deer hunting is prohibited.

name: Lewisville Lake
permitInfo: USACE permit required (valid hunter education and Texas license required). Archery white-tailed deer hunts in the Hickory Creek area are by lottery (apply July 1-31). The area north of Highway 380 is leased to the City of Denton (940-349-8230).
permitCost: No fee; deer by lottery, general permit required.
means: Archery only for feral hog and deer. Shotgun (#2 shot or smaller) for all other game. No rifles, pistols, or muzzleloaders.
legalGameText: Archery only for feral hog and deer. Shotgun (#2 shot or smaller) for all other game. No rifles, pistols, or muzzleloaders.

name: Navarro Mills Lake
permitInfo: USACE permit required for deer (archery only; printable forms on the lake website; post-season survey required). No permit needed for feral hog. Bag limits follow TPWD for Navarro and Hill counties.
means: Archery only for deer. Feral hog is archery only during any open white-tailed deer season and shotgun with slugs/sabots outside deer seasons. Other game is shotgun with non-toxic #2 shot or smaller. No rifles, pistols, or muzzleloaders.
legalGameText: Archery only for deer. Feral hog is archery only during any open white-tailed deer season and shotgun with slugs/sabots outside deer seasons. Other game is shotgun with non-toxic #2 shot or smaller. No rifles, pistols, or muzzleloaders.

name: Proctor Lake
permitInfo: Free USACE permit required for all hunters 17 and older; obtained in person or by mail at the lake office year-round. A permit covers the Sabana and Upper Leon Wildlife Management Areas and Rush Creek Hunting Area. Waterfowl in designated main-lake areas needs no permit. Deer, turkey, bobcat, and quail are prohibited.
means: Archery (including crossbows) and shotgun (non-toxic #2 shot or smaller). No rifles, pistols, muzzleloaders, or slugs/sabots.
legalGameText: Archery (including crossbows) and shotgun (non-toxic #2 shot or smaller). No rifles, pistols, muzzleloaders, or slugs/sabots.

name: Sam Rayburn Reservoir
permitInfo: No USACE hunting permit required. Follow the Texas Outdoor Annual for Angelina, Jasper, Nacogdoches, San Augustine, and Sabine counties. Baiting is prohibited for all species.
means: Archery, muzzleloaders (during muzzleloader-only season), and shotgun slugs/sabots for deer and feral hog during the general season. Other game limited to non-toxic #2 shot or smaller. Centerfire and rimfire rifles and pistols prohibited.
legalGameText: Archery, muzzleloaders (during muzzleloader-only season), and shotgun slugs/sabots for deer and feral hog during the general season. Other game limited to non-toxic #2 shot or smaller. Centerfire and rimfire rifles and pistols prohibited.

name: Somerville Lake
permitInfo: Season-long waterfowl blind locations and feral hog hunting compartments are by permit only; waterfowl blinds are assigned through a random lottery on Recreation.gov. A free first-come, first-served public waterfowl area is also available (no permanent blinds).
permitCost: Administrative fee for a permanent (season-long) waterfowl blind; public area is free.
means: Follow Texas Outdoor Annual means and methods for waterfowl and feral hog. Non-toxic shot required for waterfowl.

name: Stillhouse Hollow Lake
permitInfo: No USACE hunting permit required. Hunting is allowed on designated Wildlife Management Areas only per the Texas Outdoor Annual for Bell County. Deer, feral hog, and other unlisted game may not be taken. There is no open turkey season (occasional draw hunts only).
means: Shotgun only; shot type depends on species per state law. No archery, rifles, pistols, or muzzleloaders.

means: Archery and muzzleloaders allowed. Shotgun slugs/sabots for deer and feral hog during general season; other game limited to non-toxic #2 shot or smaller. No rifles or pistols.

name: Waco Lake
permitInfo: USACE permit required for all hunters regardless of game, available through Recreation.gov (valid Aug 15 - Aug 31). Hunters 17 and older need a permit; ages 13-16 must be accompanied by a permitted hunter; under 13 may not hunt. Hunting is limited to designated Wildlife Management Areas. Small game may be hunted any time except during open deer season.
means: Archery only for deer, feral hog, and exotics, regardless of season. Shotgun (non-toxic #2 shot or smaller) for waterfowl, dove, and small game. No rifles, pistols, muzzleloaders, or slugs.

name: Wright Patman Lake
permitInfo: No hunting user fee, but an ATV permit ($20) is required to use ATVs in the Clear Springs and Big Creek Wildlife Management Areas (3,700 acres). ATV permits are distributed first-come at the Clear Springs Park gate house (proof of a certified ATV safety course required). Baiting with corn is allowed by hand spreading or small hanging feeders. Eastern wild turkey hunting is not allowed.
permitCost: No hunting fee; $20 ATV permit (Archery, Rifle 1, Rifle 2).
means: Archery, muzzleloaders, and shotguns allowed. Rifles authorized in all areas except due east of US Highway 59, where deer and hogs are restricted to shotgun slugs and archery. Shotguns limited to non-toxic #2 shot or smaller.
